hints.text: This clue's indicator is 'The essence of', and it's a selection indicator. Often 'essence' will point to the core or central letter of a word ('essence', 'core' and 'centre' all being synonyms). But another meaning of 'essence' is 'substance' - that which is not superficial - and it's used in this clue to indicate that we should select the internal letters of some neighbouring fodder.
This clue's fodder is 'simplicity'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).
Our definition here is 'it doesn't need to be said', and our answer will be another way of expressing that idea.
